The '''Mark V Commando Droid''' was a model of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] that the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Liam Dentiri]] used to test the combat prowess of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] students at the [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. The Mark V was the final of the five levels of testing.<ref name="The Old Republic" />
